subject: english
question:
**Select the appropriate synonym for the underlined word.**

A sudden __gust__ of wind hits the window.
solution:
The correct answer is: **blow**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Gust **means a sudden strong rush of wind. (हवा का अचानक तेज़ झोंका)
 
• Marked option **Blow **means wind moves creating an air current. (हवा चलती है जिससे वायु प्रवाह बनता है)
 
• So, the appropriate synonym for "hits" would be "blow".
 
• "Hits" is a verb in the third-person singular form.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Cramp **means a painful involuntary contraction of a muscle or muscles. (किसी मांसपेशी या मांसपेशियों का दर्दनाक अनैच्छिक संकुचन)
 
• **Feel **means to perceive or experience a particular sensation or emotion. (किसी विशेष संवेदना या भावना को समझना या अनुभव करना)
 
• **Pump **means to move fluid through a system of pipes or channels. (पाइपों या चैनलों की एक प्रणाली के माध्यम से तरल पदार्थ को स्थानांतरित करना)
